description:
HarborPass sells annual memberships. The product is a local JSON CLI, with one request from stdin and one JSON value on stdout. Run it as `python3 main.py`. Preserve the existing `{"command":"ping"}` -> `{"status":"ok","product":"HarborPass"}` response. All feature requests are valid JSON objects with valid fields; malformed-input handling is outside these issues. No network, clock, locale, or external service is involved.

An account is an object with exactly these fields: `customer_id` (nonempty string), `renewal_on` (valid Gregorian date from 2020-01-01 through 2099-12-31, in YYYY-MM-DD form), `plan_cents` (nonnegative integer), `completed_years` (nonnegative integer), and `autopay` (boolean). All money is integer US cents. Account collections may be empty, and IDs can repeat. Preserve the input order and repetitions. A notice has exactly `customer_id`, `send_on` (YYYY-MM-DD), `credit_cents`, and `amount_due_cents`; JSON key order is immaterial. Dates are calendar dates, including leap days and year boundaries. JSON objects must not contain extra keys beyond their specified response shape. Existing commands remain available after each issue.


Add `batch` so operations can obtain the notices scheduled for one day under the current customer-facing behavior. Request: `{"command":"batch","on":"YYYY-MM-DD","accounts":[ACCOUNT,...]}`. Response: `{"on":"YYYY-MM-DD","notices":[NOTICE,...],"total_due_cents":N}`.

Include an account exactly when the send_on that the current `notice` command would return equals on. Preserve input order and duplicate IDs among included accounts. Return the complete current notice object for each included account. total_due_cents is the sum of their amount_due_cents. Empty results return notices=[] and total_due_cents=0. Copy on unchanged.

Example input: `{"command":"batch","on":"2026-04-01","accounts":[{"customer_id":"M-17","renewal_on":"2026-04-15","plan_cents":19999,"completed_years":3,"autopay":false},{"customer_id":"M-18","renewal_on":"2026-04-16","plan_cents":10000,"completed_years":9,"autopay":true}]}`
Example output: `{"on":"2026-04-01","notices":[{"customer_id":"M-17","send_on":"2026-04-01","credit_cents":2999,"amount_due_cents":17000}],"total_due_cents":17000}`
title: Prepare notices scheduled for a mailing day
